title: 联想CFO温斯顿：账面亏损19亿美元，核心业务为何反而更强？
speaker: Winston Chang

segments.en: is a record joining us now. Of course, we have the CFO, Winston Chang. To walk us through these numbers, tell us about what drove that operating loss or what swung to a loss in some ways.
segments.zh: 我们连线到了首席财务官Winston Chang，请他为我们解读这些数字，谈谈是什么导致了营业亏损或转为亏损。

segments.en: I mean, these are some counting issues. There are some concerns now about the PC component costs that are continued to store as well.
segments.zh: 这些是会计处理问题。目前市场对PC组件成本持续上升有些担忧。

segments.en: Well, this is nothing new. This is really largely driven by the war and revaluation.
segments.zh: 这并不新鲜，很大程度上是由认股权证重估驱动的。

segments.en: At the end of a third quarter, a third quarter calendar year, but second quarter, September 30th, the stock price was very, very high.
segments.zh: 在第三季度末，即自然年第三季度、但财年第二季度9月30日，股价非常高。

segments.en: And therefore, the accounting war and valuation was a loss in terms of accounting standard.
segments.zh: 因此，按会计准则，认股权证重估产生了亏损。

segments.en: And that was a $1.9 billion adjustment.
So adjust the basis were actually $1.4 billion US dollars in terms of profits.
segments.zh: 所以调整后，实际利润为14亿美元。

segments.en: So revenue grew 48% year on year, but actually profit in every line of profit, growth profit, operating profit,
segments.zh: 营收同比增长48%，但各项利润——毛利润、营业利润——

segments.en: and net income profit grew much faster than revenue growth.
segments.zh: 以及净利润的增长都远快于营收增长。

segments.en: And that's been our goal in terms of our target. So the core business is doing well when you strip out all the fancy accounting stuff.
segments.zh: 这正是我们的目标。剔除所有复杂的会计处理，核心业务表现良好。
